title: Cars look familiar, no glitches, smooth traffic

items.name: Glitch: lamp patches z-fighting at range (polygonOffset on all lamp materials)
Glitch: LOD flicker at switch distance (hysteresis 0.12)
Soft contact shadow under every car
Separate tail-lamp lenses, bumper shut lines, plate recess and lamp bar
Cleaner wear mix (most city cars washed, rust only on old cars)
80s convertible (Tarpon Bayline Cabrio) for the ref_51 bar
Traffic: smoothed steering and progressive pedals (traffic/smooth.js)
Bodies redesigned to read as familiar real-world kinds (fascias, glasshouse, crisp feature lines)
Minivan, delivery-van and police-SUV specific bodies
Triangle and draw-call budget (now about 39k tris and 40 calls per car at LOD0)
Street before/after shots South Beach and Downtown at the same camera
Traffic: signals, turn signals, spawn-in-view and jitter checked on screen
